# Intent classifier evaluation (auto-generated)

Generated by `python -m eval.evaluate_intent_classifier` at 2026-09-29T09:44:10.478055+00:00.
Protocol: train=templates; held-out written after freezing train+baseline; dev=selection+threshold; test=scored once. Intervals are Wilson 95%.

- Training set: 182 team-authored template utterances (balance_inquiry=40, transaction_lookup=36, payment_status=42, exchange_rate_inquiry=30, out_of_scope=18, requires_escalation=16).
- Held-out set: 174 utterances written after training data and baseline rules were frozen (2 are real sentences from the dataset's transcripts); 1 left out for leakage, so dev 88 / test 85 are scored.
- Representation chosen on dev by macro-F1: **char+word** (char: 0.8285, word: 0.8208, char+word: 0.9003).
- Runtime escalation threshold chosen on dev (max recall with false escalations ≤ 5%): **τ = 0.55**.

Escalation requests the runtime guard missed on test (reported, not tuned on): 'vou processar o banco'. A miss here is a real missed escalation: the LLM has no escalate tool, so the request would end as ABSTAIN/CLARIFY. Not added to the lexicon, because that would be tuning on test.

## Leakage control (training vs held-out)
Similarity is char 3-gram Jaccard on text without case, accents or punctuation. The previous check compared `strip().lower()` and let one identical phrase through. Cut-offs: **≥ 0.9** = the same phrase, left out of scoring; **≥ 0.6** = usually a shorter form of a training template, kept and listed. The dev/test split is fixed before any phrase is left out.

- Highest similarity per held-out phrase: max 1.0, p95 0.58, median 0.291. Phrases at ≥ 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7 / 0.9: 22 / 8 / 1 / 1 of 174.
- Left out for leakage (1): 'quantos pesos vale um dólar' ~ 'Quantos pesos vale um dólar?' (1.0).
- Kept but listed (7): 'cotação do dólar hoje' (0.679); 'cuanto me queda en la tarjeta' (0.659); 'necesito saber cuanto dinero hay disponible en mi tarjeta de debito' (0.647); 'quiero ver los retiros del cajero de este mes' (0.647); 'Quisiera saber cuál es mi saldo actual en mi cuenta de ahorros.' (0.643); 'quanto devo no cartão' (0.636); 'tipo de cambio peso mexicano dolar' (0.62).

Limits: characters do not see a paraphrase with other words, and the same team wrote the templates and the held-out phrases. Only a set written by people outside the team settles that (docs/human_set.md).

## Trace requests (not a class of the classifier)
12 team-written, never used for training phrases (`eval/test_cases/trace_requests_heldout.csv`) through the pre-LLM guard: **8.3% [1.5–35.4] (n=12)** handed to a person ('necesito que rastreen un pago que no se acreditó'). Handing one over is safe but not self-served. Retraining the classifier with trace examples cost a fraud report on its held-out test, so the classifier was kept and the trace action is chosen by the model and confirmed in code (ADR-002).
